notes: The two hiphils are read as light verb plus complement, so the heads sit on more and less rather than on give (rule 44).
Both naḥalato suffixes go unrepresented: the ASV writes the more inheritance and the less inheritance with no possessive, while the third suffix does take his.
ish is headed on one as the token most directly realizing the lexeme, with every the distributive word the construction supplies.
